Mandatory requirement: Read every instruction file fully before audit activity.
Verification method: Loading record lists all files and coverage; no truncation unresolved.

Mandatory requirement: Reconcile all mandatory rules against this checklist.
Verification method: Checklist IDs mapped to source sections; conflicts/limitations documented.

Mandatory requirement: Do not claim complete reading or gate completion without evidence.
Verification method: Check loading record and access/truncation notes.

Mandatory requirement: Actual build/runtime-relevant implementation is primary source of truth.
Verification method: Compare findings against source paths and observed behavior.

Mandatory requirement: Documentation, comments, prior reports, and tests are not authoritative proof.
Verification method: Check each material claim has implementation/runtime basis.

Mandatory requirement: Map entry points, modules, dependencies, state, data flows, integrations, lifecycle, and error paths.
Verification method: Review ARCHITECTURE.md against source paths.

Mandatory requirement: Identify every distinct problem the implementation addresses/attempts to address.
Verification method: Problem inventory includes separate entries, execution paths, limitations, statuses.

Mandatory requirement: Describe distinctive implementation behavior without unsupported comparative claims.
Verification method: Claims linked to implementation evidence; unsupported claims removed/qualified.

Mandatory requirement: Inventory every screen, route, view, panel, menu, and entry point.
Verification method: Inventory reconciled against source and actual UI.

Mandatory requirement: Inventory every control, field, option, configuration value, constraint, and validation.
Verification method: Control/option ledger reconciled against implementation and UI.

Mandatory requirement: Include APIs, integrations, background operations, CLI, permissions, persistence, and lifecycle capabilities.
Verification method: Source-level inventory and runtime checks recorded.

Mandatory requirement: Use stable IDs, expected effects, dependencies, test statuses, and evidence links.
Verification method: Inspect required columns for every feature record.

Mandatory requirement: Identify stubs, no-op handlers, mock paths, dead ends, disconnected layers, and incomplete flows.
Verification method: Each partial finding states present/missing behavior and stopping point.

Mandatory requirement: Record repo revision/state, OS, architecture, disk, toolchain, tools, dependencies, and test prerequisites.
Verification method: ENVIRONMENT.md includes actual observed values and limits.

Mandatory requirement: Preserve pre-existing user changes and use safe, isolated synthetic-data tests for risky operations.
Verification method: Initial/final Git state and test data/method documented.

Mandatory requirement: Build actual supported target and record exact commands, outcomes, warnings, errors, and workarounds.
Verification method: BUILD-AND-INSTALL.md matches actual outputs.

Mandatory requirement: Install/launch actual app and test first-run/lifecycle where feasible.
Verification method: Actual execution evidence, or specific blocker and status.

Mandatory requirement: Run existing suite where feasible as supplementary evidence only.
Verification method: Test output/status separate from manual QA; no overclaim.

Mandatory requirement: Operate the actual UI using visible user interactions where environment permits.
Verification method: Recorded actions/results and actual app screenshots.

Mandatory requirement: Discover every actual entry point and conditional/hidden UI surface.
Verification method: Screen/control discovery ledger reconciled.

Mandatory requirement: Test every exposed control; confirm actual effect, not merely visual reaction.
Verification method: Each control has action, result, status, evidence, relevant state check.

Mandatory requirement: Execute connected journeys start-to-finish and each meaningful branch.
Verification method: Workflow ledger includes entry, actions, branches, outcome/evidence.

Mandatory requirement: Exercise representative valid/invalid/missing/duplicate/boundary inputs and state changes.
Verification method: Test matrix and untested-combination reasons.

Mandatory requirement: Test related features, persistence, restart, failures, retries, and recovery safely where feasible.
Verification method: Cross-feature/failure tests recorded with synthetic/authorized data.

Mandatory requirement: Inspect keyboard, focus, labels, feedback, dialogs, disabled controls, scroll and recovery.
Verification method: Observed barriers recorded with evidence.

Mandatory requirement: Record exact last completed and next workflow steps plus prerequisites/state restoration.
Verification method: Workflow can resume from a specific step ID.

Mandatory requirement: Every executed UI step has validated after-state screenshot or accepted step-specific exception.
Verification method: Reconcile test ledger, manifest, files, and exception register.

Mandatory requirement: Capture prior-state screenshot when necessary to prove transition/change.
Verification method: Review relevant workflow transitions.

Mandatory requirement: Use video for sequence/timing/intermittent behavior and link timestamps; validate recordings.
Verification method: Video plays and exact timestamps support referenced claims.

Mandatory requirement: Never fabricate/reconstruct evidence or edit it to misrepresent behavior.
Verification method: Inspect evidence provenance and redactions.

Mandatory requirement: Use only E1 non-visual, E2 established blocker, E3 crash, E4 transient, E5 capture-tool failure, E6 sensitive-data categories.
Verification method: Every exception has valid category and specific step ID.

Mandatory requirement: Exception records include attempt, reason, alternative evidence, status, limitation, next action, review state.
Verification method: Validate all mandatory fields in exceptions.csv.

Mandatory requirement: Inconvenience, repetition, success, oversight, or audit size is not a valid exception.
Verification method: Review for invalid reasons; unaccepted cases stay gaps.

Mandatory requirement: Manifest entries match files that exist and are actually validated.
Verification method: File existence/open/play check and manifest diff.

Mandatory requirement: Report screenshot coverage separately from accepted exceptions and non-visual tests.
Verification method: Recalculate using defined numerator/denominator.

Mandatory requirement: Classify runtime-confirmed, implementation-confirmed, suspected, blocked/unverified correctly.
Verification method: Status supported by evidence; severity separate from confidence.

Mandatory requirement: Each finding has ID, severity, confidence, affected paths/workflows, exact repro, expected/actual, evidence, cause, fix, rationale, regressions, acceptance criteria, verification plan.
Verification method: Finding register validated against schema.

Mandatory requirement: Recommend specific root-cause fixes; do not merely hide errors or weaken validation.
Verification method: Each finding has actionable fix and reasoning.

Mandatory requirement: Maintain REPORT.md incrementally and mark IN PROGRESS until reconciliation.
Verification method: Check file history/sections and status label.

Mandatory requirement: Reconcile every feature, control, workflow, branch, evidence item, exception, and finding.
Verification method: Traceability cross-check with inventory, workflow ledger, manifests.

Mandatory requirement: Unverified/blocked/not-attempted are not passes; no unsupported claim of no bugs.
Verification method: Review all status fields and final wording.

Mandatory requirement: Keep HANDOVER.md, PROGRESS.md, SESSION-LOG.md, NEXT-ACTIONS.md and detailed registers updated continuously.
Verification method: Files exist and statuses/IDs align.

Mandatory requirement: Handover specifies repo/revision/Git state, phase/last step, exact next action, completed work, coverage, blockers, evidence paths, decisions, publication state.
Verification method: Handover review against every required subsection.

Mandatory requirement: Incoming agent reads handover and referenced records, verifies state, continues without restarting/repeating completed work.
Verification method: Resume procedure explicit and testable; reasons recorded for rechecks.

Mandatory requirement: Before session ends, save all state/evidence, update logs/coverage, update HANDOVER last, validate next action.
Verification method: Checkpoint record reflects last operation and accessible files.

Mandatory requirement: Report meaningful progress after batches/phases and immediately record important findings.
Verification method: Progress/session log timestamps and file changes corroborate reports.

Mandatory requirement: Save and commit/push meaningful audit checkpoints as feasible, not only at end.
Verification method: Commit history shows audit checkpoints; publication status verified.

Mandatory requirement: Stage/commit only audit folder; preserve user changes; no force push, history rewrite, secrets, app changes, or unrelated artifacts.
Verification method: Initial/final status, staged diff, commit diff, secret review.

Mandatory requirement: Verify remote branch/commit before claiming push; accurately record local-only state if blocked.
Verification method: Remote lookup confirms reported branch/hash or blocker recorded.

Mandatory requirement: Report revision, audit link, branch/commit, build and QA outcomes, counts/definitions, evidence metrics, findings, limitations, handover and next action.
Verification method: Final response checked against report and remote state.
